what_keeps_banks_open.reading: Most open banks trace to a genus that is itself open. A Wiktionary genus word carries all its definitions (act, state, quality, person: dozens each), and their union is open almost everywhere. The WordNet chains end at roots that no axiom determines (entity.n.01 holds only GOOD 0 and SOMETHING+), and verb genera such as change.v.01 and be.v.01 are themselves mostly open.

interpretations_made: Axioms: prime-linked definitions (prime_entries) whose own nonzero bank the release settles, and every gse_closed_class entry (declared components; 0 elsewhere, including determiners that declare none).
A genus word with several definitions: their union. A WordNet sense with several hypernyms: the intersection (it is a kind of each). The lemma entries of one synset: their union.
Differentia are the clause heads definition_structure parses (one per that/which/who/used/having clause), not every content word; prepositional phrases are not differentia, as in the ported parser.
A bank is 'touched' when a differentia word can be nonzero there; where touching is undecided the kind keeps the union. An undefined word is unknown on every bank.
Negated glosses and the not/relating-to/having templates carry no edge: the parser does not say which differentia a negative scopes over, and 'relating to X' is not a kind of X.
A Wiktionary sense that the source marks form_of/alt_of takes that word as its genus (the source states the identity).
The genus is looked up in the kind's own part of speech (adverbs of manner: the adjective). Proper names are neither kinds nor genus.
part.n.01 is prime-linked but was withdrawn as an identity root (SP-1), so its axiom does not flow to the kinds WordNet files under it.
